33a_triage_engine.question: nine rings of registers can answer any day-0 question — but only if a human assembles them per GUID. can the registers themselves become ONE queryable weapon that places any future dump artifact instantly, and can it prove its own correctness before it is trusted?
33a_triage_engine.answer: YES — lab/fw33-triage-engine.py (tracked in lab/, stdlib-only, loads the seven registers relative to its own directory) exposes guid / body / rung / plan / wave / agesa / selftest / manifest modes; the self-test runs 29 genome-exact gates and the engine REFUSES to serve if any register drifts (AGESA pin aborts at load, gates abort at self-test)

vendor-flash-armor.json probes carry PRESENCE lists (added_present = the wave members present in that image), not per-release addition events — replaying them cumulatively double-counts (5->10->15); each probe's list IS that rung's expected membership

33b_law_of_the_landing.question: ring 32 left the residue-class census as an open-by-choice thread: WHAT sets the final landing above the boundary — why {moat-0xA0, -0xD0, -0x180} and not one value, and why depth 543 in every storm so far?
33b_law_of_the_landing.answer: THE LAW: the fatal window has width EXACTLY one chain step (0x660 = 0x3A8 stub push + 0x2B8 write offset), so every chain has EXACTLY one fatal delivery, forced by the onset SP alone; depth is invariant (543) because the onset band is narrow, and the residue is a pure function of the onset alignment mod 0x660

census.parallel_batches: 8 batches x 3 parallel QEMU instances, separate disk copies, 90 s timeouts, passive -d int

33b_law_of_the_landing.why_depth_is_invariant: the fatal window [MOAT-0x2B8, MOAT+0x3A8) has width exactly 0x660 = one chain step, so exactly ONE delivery of any chain lands in it regardless of onset; every observed onset sits in the recovery-ceiling band [MOAT+0xD8168, MOAT+0xD8248], which maps to k*=543; the depth was never a coincidence — it is forced geometry
33b_law_of_the_landing.why_residues_vary: the landing = onset - 542*0x660 inherits the onset's sub-0x660 alignment; the oscillation's partial unwinds recover to different alignments (0x30/0xB0-granular steps observed), and the residue is just 0x3A8 minus that alignment — the residue classes ARE the recovery-alignment classes of the oscillation ceiling

hang_census.reading: runs up to 542 consecutive at-RET deliveries observed RECOVERING (one step short of the fatal 543) — the fatal window entry, not exhaustion, is the only killer; ring 32's 513-deep recovery is now part of a 10-point depth distribution

33b_law_of_the_landing.terminal_state_refinement: both ring-33 storms show ec=124 (process did NOT exit): after the fatal #PF the event stream goes SILENT (no further -d int events until the kill) — the lane's terminals measured precisely: (a) indefinite oscillation, (b) fatal-crossing-then-silence; ring 32's 'only end states are fatal crossing or hang' refines to 'both terminals are kills'
33b_law_of_the_landing.rate_second_build: the ring-33 build storms 2/24 (binomial honesty: rule-of-three upper bound ~12.5% at 95%) vs the ring-32 build's 3/8 — a SECOND data point confirming ring 32's correction: the rate is BUILD-scoped, not a constant of the design; pooled 5/32

walls: the residue support is NOT exhausted: three classes observed over five storms; the law predicts the full support = {0x3A8 - a : a in reachable recovery alignments}, and the alignment set of future storms is a property of the TCG scheduler, not of the payload
the law is lane-scoped: it describes the SMMSTORE lane's HPET cascade over the SEC-carved moat; the EMU lane's green boots never enter the cascade
the QEMU softmmu caveat stands (ring 31): walk-time A/D bits are host-side; the law's verdicts rest only on RW=0 geometry and SP/CR2 arithmetic, robust to that subtlety

TCG scheduling dependence: onset selection and per-delivery fate are scheduler properties; on real silicon the constants (0x660, 0x3A8, 0x2B8, the window) may differ but the LAW-FORM (one fatal delivery per chain, forced depth, alignment-determined residue) is geometry and is expected to survive with silicon-specific constants
